fields.label: Service
fields.fallback_instruction: Fixed to "conversion rate optimisation (CRO)" for this stage; only include companies with a genuine, identifiable CRO offering (dedicated CRO service page, described process such as audits/A-B testing/landing page optimisation/funnel analysis, or case studies with concrete conversion-lift results) — a page that only mentions "conversion" in passing does not count.
fields.raw_explanation: service: "conversion rate optimisation (CRO)" — only include companies with a genuine, identifiable CRO offering.

fields.label: Niche
fields.fallback_instruction: If not specified, infer the target's core industry from the site and match competitors within it. If explicitly left open, do not restrict by niche.
fields.raw_explanation: {NICHE} — the target's industry/vertical (e.g. the same industry as {TARGET_URL}).

fields.label: Location
fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to Australia-wide if not specified. If provided, prioritise competitors based in or explicitly serving that location, and rank local leaders higher.

fields.label: Competitor Type
fields.fallback_instruction: If missing or empty, include both types.
fields.raw_explanation: "niche_specialist" = a company specialised in the target's core service/industry, offering CRO as part of that specialism. "full_stack_niche" = a full-service company in the same industry as the target that prominently offers CRO as one of several services.

fields.label: Excluded Competitors
fields.fallback_instruction: Auto-populated from this same competitor-analysis stage's own prior output(s) for this client (system-managed dedup), per REVIEW_NEEDED_V2.md item 7 resolution -- the user does not manually retype domains. If no prior run exists for this client/stage, treated as an empty list rather than prompting the user.
fields.raw_explanation: excluded_competitors: [list any domains already sourced in prior runs]
